instruction.text: Select the living thing in this image.

feedback.correct: All living things do certain things to show that they are living. For example, in this image we can see the dog moving by itself.

instruction.text: Match the adult animals to their offspring.

hint.text: Offspring is the scientific name for the children of living things. You are the offspring of your parents.
hint.label: Offspring

finish.text: All living things reproduce to create their offspring. Some animals, such as swans, will even mate for life!

instruction.text: Sort the chickens, starting with the youngest at the top.

feedback.end: All living things grow. Over time, a baby chick will grow into a fully-grown adult chicken!

instruction.text: Select the living things eating in this photograph.

feedback.correct: We are living things too! All living things must eat in order to get energy.

instruction.text: Find the pig’s body parts to find out more.

feedback.correct: The pig uses these body parts to see, hear and smell. These are three of its senses! All living things are able to use their senses to understand the world around them.
